description: This file implements a UART driver for the Zephyr RTOS, specifically for the Microchip MIV UART hardware. It includes register definitions, initialization, polling, interrupt handling, and a thread workaround for IRQs.

methods.name: uart_miv_poll_out
methods.description: Sends a character via UART by polling the status register.

methods.name: uart_miv_poll_in
methods.description: Receives a character via UART by polling the status register.

methods.name: uart_miv_err_check
methods.description: Checks UART error status flags for parity, overflow, and framing errors.

methods.name: uart_miv_fifo_fill
methods.description: Fills the UART transmit FIFO with data, used in interrupt-driven mode.

methods.name: uart_miv_fifo_read
methods.description: Reads data from UART receive FIFO, used in interrupt-driven mode.

methods.name: uart_miv_irq_tx_enable
methods.description: Enables UART transmit interrupt (stub).

methods.name: uart_miv_irq_tx_disable
methods.description: Disables UART transmit interrupt (stub).

methods.name: uart_miv_irq_tx_ready
methods.description: Checks if UART is ready to transmit.

methods.name: uart_miv_irq_tx_complete
methods.description: Checks if UART transmission is complete.

methods.name: uart_miv_irq_rx_enable
methods.description: Enables UART receive interrupt (stub).

methods.name: uart_miv_irq_rx_disable
methods.description: Disables UART receive interrupt (stub).

methods.name: uart_miv_irq_rx_ready
methods.description: Checks if UART has received data.

methods.name: uart_miv_irq_err_enable
methods.description: Enables UART error interrupt (stub).

methods.name: uart_miv_irq_err_disable
methods.description: Disables UART error interrupt (stub).

methods.name: uart_miv_irq_is_pending
methods.description: Checks if an interrupt is pending.

methods.name: uart_miv_irq_update
methods.description: Updates UART interrupt status (stub).

methods.name: uart_miv_irq_handler
methods.description: Handles UART interrupt by invoking callback.

methods.name: uart_miv_rx_thread
methods.description: Polling thread for UART receive data as a workaround for missing IRQs.

methods.name: uart_miv_irq_callback_set
methods.description: Sets the callback function for UART interrupts.

methods.name: uart_miv_init
methods.description: Initializes UART hardware, sets baud rate, and configures interrupts.
